ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The lower shaded part in the figure is a topographic profile along 30°N, the horizontal axis is longitude, and the vertical direction represents height. The parallelogram represents the distribution of isobars on the 6000 m high-altitude horizontal plane, in which M is located near about 90°E, and N is located near about 110°E; the dashed lines in the figure project M and N downward respectively to the corresponding ground points M′ and N′. From the profile, the terrain where M′ is located is relatively high, located on a plateau or mountainous terrain; the terrain where N′ is located is clearly lower, close to a low and flat area. Then reason: The higher the altitude, the thinner the atmosphere, the less solar radiation is weakened, and illumination is usually stronger; in lower-altitude areas, the atmosphere is thicker, and water vapor, clouds and fog, etc. weaken solar radiation more obviously, so illumination is relatively less. Therefore, compared with M′, N′ has less illumination.

raw_record.question_text:
Read the figure: The shaded part of this figure is a vertical profile of part of the region along 30°N, and inside the parallelogram is the distribution of isobars (unit: hPa) on the 6000m high-altitude horizontal plane corresponding to this region at a certain time. <image1>

Compared with M′ on the ground corresponding to M, how is the illumination condition of N′ on the ground corresponding to N?

method.method_draft: 先读图：在6000 m水平面的平行四边形中找到M、N，再沿图中的虚线下投到地面对应点M′、N′。剖面阴影显示M′位于约90°E附近的高大高原/山地地形上，而N′位于约110°E附近明显较低的地面。读题干可知阴影部分是沿30°N的垂直剖面，问题比较N′相对M′的光照。关键规则：海拔越高，大气层越薄，太阳辐射被削弱越少，光照通常越强；低海拔地区大气厚、水汽和云雾影响更大，光照较弱。因此N′与M′相比光照少。
method.CoT_raw:
先描述图像：图中下部阴影是沿30°N的地形剖面，横轴为经度，纵向表示高度。平行四边形表示6000 m高空水平面等压线分布，其中M位于约90°E附近，N位于约110°E附近；图中虚线把M、N分别下投到地面对应点M′、N′。从剖面看，M′所在位置地势较高，位于高原或山地地形上；N′所在位置地势明显较低，接近低平地区。
再推理：海拔越高，大气层越薄，太阳辐射被削弱越少，光照通常较强；海拔较低地区大气层较厚，水汽、云雾等对太阳辐射削弱更明显，光照相对较少。因此，N′与M′相比，光照较少。
